meta.title: For manufacturers
meta.description: Enter Kenya and East Africa without opening a local office. ItalBridge Partners finds qualified buyers, structures deals and coordinates delivery and after-sales from Nairobi.

hero.title: Enter East Africa without opening a local office.
hero.text: We act as your commercial presence in Kenya and the region — finding qualified buyers, structuring deals and coordinating delivery and after-sales from Nairobi.

items.title: Qualified demand
items.text: Buyers with real equipment needs, checked for capacity and timelines before you quote.

items.title: Clear technical briefs
items.text: Specifications, volumes and constraints assessed and written up so you can respond quickly.

items.title: Deals handled
items.text: Negotiation, payment terms and contract conditions coordinated with the buyer.

items.title: Local after-sales
items.text: Installation, spare parts and service questions coordinated in Nairobi on your behalf.

numbers.title: The opportunity, in numbers.
numbers.text: Kenya's industrial machinery spending rose 94.8% year on year in Q3 2025. In packaging machinery, Italy already holds 14.5% of a €117M market.

items.text: Share your products, capacity and export experience.

items.text: Capability, capacity, quality and export readiness.
